ns2:section.sectionText: This semester, this course introduces students to the basics of neural network modeling. It emphasizes the formal characteristics of the main classes of networks and the evaluation of neural networks as models of human perception and cognition. The course requires familiarity with basic mathematics (matrix algebra and calculus are recommended but not required; basic algebra is a must) and computer programming skills. This course meets with PSYC 331 AL1. NOTE: Students must also register for a lab section, either PSYC 593 AB1 crn 47523 or PSYC 593 AB2 crn 47524.
